g.text: AI Accountability Chat Assistant & Photo Triage RAG
"Who is the contractor responsible for S.V. Road (SV-RD-01),
why is the drainage project halted, and what is the SLA chain?"
Based on live PostgreSQL records for S.V. Road (Code: SV-RD-01, ID #3):
1. Primary Contract (#PRJ-03): SV Road Drainage Trenching & Microtunnelling
was awarded ₹9.50 Cr (₹4.50 Cr spent) to Omega Infrastructure Corp.
2. Halted & Blacklisted: Project is HALTED at 378 delay days. Contractor
CON-00010 is BLACKLISTED for surface peeling within 3 months.
● Level 2 (>48h Breach): NHAI RO Mumbai / Chief Vigilance Commissioner
Budget Variance Reason (#BVR-02): Basalt rock strata delay logged
Ask about any road, contractor, tender, or attach defect photo...
JOIN projects p ON p.road_id = r.id
BOUND DBMS RELATIONS: roads, projects, contractors, authorities, complaints, sla_config
